records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Revenues decreased 6.0% for the thirteen weeks ended June 3, 2023, compared to a decrease of 2.4% for the thirteen weeks ended May 28, 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Pharmacy same store sales increased 13.3% for the thirteen week period ended June 3, 2023 compared to an increase of 6.6% in the thirteen week period ended May 28, 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our net loss for the thirteen week period ended June 3, 2023 was $306.7 million or $5.56 per basic and diluted share compared to a net loss of $110.2 million or $2.03 per basic and diluted share for the thirteen week period ended May 28, 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Other factors contributing to the higher net loss were higher restructuring-related charges, a lower gain on sale of assets, higher interest expense, and a decrease in Adjusted EBITDA.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash used in operating activities was $372.5 million and $252.2 million for the thirteen week periods ended June 3, 2023 and May 28, 2022, respectively.
